name: Django
summary: A Python framework for full web apps, with pages, a database layer and an admin screen built in.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the BSD 3-Clause license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Runs on any server that speaks WSGI or ASGI, such as Gunicorn or Uvicorn, so many hosts can run it.

language.note: Written in Python, with HTML templates for pages.

has_server_code.note: Views run only on the server and render pages there, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Pages are Django templates rendered on the server, not React components.

setup.step: Create the project with django-admin startproject and push it to a GitHub repository.
Before going live, read SECRET_KEY from an environment variable and set DEBUG to False.

builder_notes: Settings live in settings.py. Read secrets there with os.environ, for example SECRET_KEY = os.environ["SECRET_KEY"], and never commit them.
Set DEBUG = False and fill ALLOWED_HOSTS in production. Do not use manage.py runserver in production; use Gunicorn or Uvicorn.
